lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank; these transition to a higher density of smaller, more randomly distributed clusters in the anterior region proximal to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse, elevated pixel intensity running dorso-ventrally that intersect with the centroid clusters to form a structured grid of nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient transition from a light superior edge to a dark inferior shadow, consistent with a longitudinal dermal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated, high-luminance pisciform objects are visible ventrally to the trailing edge of the pectoral fin, exhibiting distinct silhouettes from the background water column.
